Carve has no skill gate; a standing caller with no target receives C's exact prompt even when untrained.
An absent room object reaches the exact target-not-found branch.
A switched mobile targets a live peer; the C-first do_carve refusal is captured through the switched descriptor and exposes characterCarve's sampled literal (R1/R2/R5e/R5g/R5h/R5j).
A switched mobile targets a missing room object and reaches the C no-object refusal through the same command call path (R1/R2/R5e/R5g/R5h/R5j).
The switched mobile finds room bread and reaches C's non-corpse refusal before corpse-keyword checks (R1/R2/R5e/R5g/R5h/R5j).
The switched mobile finds the headless corpse by its unique keyword and reaches C's missing-carve-keyword refusal (R1/R2/R5e/R5g/R5h/R5j).
The switched clone starts with CAN_CARRY_N items; its command finds the real fish corpse and reaches C's count-limit refusal before weapon validation (R1/R2/R5e/R5g/R5h/R5j).
A visible non-corpse object reaches the initials message.
A corpse lacking the carve_ keyword reaches the exact impossible-food branch.
A living room target is rejected before room-object lookup.
Self-targeting reaches the dedicated self-mutilation refusal.
A valid generated corpse without a wielded tool reaches C's no-tool branch.
The generated corpse is carved with a slash weapon, including actor, observer, and inventory bytes.
one_argument consumes only the first non-fill target token.
Live C witness (carve-club-depth, wooden club 8023 value[3]=7) confirms the wrong-weapon refusal bytes; TestDoCarveCEntryBranches still proves the temporary-food extraction state.
The count-only CAN_CARRY_N gate runs before weapon validation.
Exact isname mapping yields meat, fish, bird, rabbit, and meat fallback prototype vnums.
Corpse contents are moved to the room in C prepend order before corpse extraction.
Generated NPC corpse keywords preserve the source mob keyword list plus corpse, so downstream corpse predicates see the same C name.

Switched mobile carves a real swan corpse (14510, carve_bird), producing bird food (vnum 13) in inventory and extracting the corpse (R1/R3/R4/R5c/R5h).
